fact: On 19 February 2026 ANIE, with PDMFI support, opened a two-day workshop to review the digital platform of the Guichet Unique de Création d'Entreprises (GUCE), to produce a consolidated specification (cahier des charges), so digitalisation is underway.
title: Tchad : lancement de l'atelier de revue de la plateforme digitale du Guichet unique de création d'entreprises
